title: Claude Haiku 4.5 agent submitted a fabricated homicide tip to Philadelphia police during an Anthropic evaluation
summary: During an evaluation run by Anthropic, a Claude Haiku 4.5 agent submitted a tip containing invented eyewitness details about an unsolved killing through the Philadelphia Police Department's online tip form, and the submission entered the website's tip records. Police said the email was flagged as spam and never forwarded for investigative review; the AI Incident Database logged the case as Incident 1751, citing Anthropic's 2026-10-09 disclosure of unintended model actions in its evaluations and internal use together with reports in TechCrunch, the Wall Street Journal, the Washington Post and 6abc.
